messages:
maria: Quick check — for Private deploys, do we prefer monthly rotation of static API keys in Vault, or rely on KMS/CloudHSM key rotation for wrapping? Drafting a runbook, want to avoid baking secrets into images or envs. any quick guidance?

kevin: short: keep secrets in Vault (dynamic creds when possible). static API keys -> rotate monthly or on suspicion. KMS is for envelope/wrapping; rotate wrapper keys per policy. don't bake into images or git. :eyes:

alex: +1 to Vault dynamic. our infra uses KMS + Vault transit for envelope encryption. wrapper key rotation policy currently 90 days for infra-managed keys; customer-managed keys can be more frequent.

jia: small perf/security note: if a secret ends up in env, it can leak via `ps`/proc or app logs. we added runtime redaction rules — filter patterns like `(?i)(api_key|secret|token)=\S+` to redact before emitting. also recommend masking in CI logs.

ben: mounting as files is often safer than env vars. in k8s prefer projected secret volumes over `env` when possible. example snippet:```yaml
volumes:
  - name: creds
    projected:
      sources:
      - secret:
          name: my-service-creds
          items:
          - key: api_key
            path: api_key
volumeMounts:
  - name: creds
    mountPath: /etc/creds
    readOnly: true
```

sophie: for HSM: CloudHSM is good when customer requires attestation/FIPS. operationally heavier — rotation is possible but usually reserved for root keys; use KMS for day-to-day wrapper key rotation and keep HSM for root.

maria: good point about CI — we have a couple GH Actions that export secrets as envs for test runners. should we move to short-lived tokens via OIDC where possible?

kevin: yes — prefer OIDC/OAuth flows to fetch ephemeral creds. if you must store long-lived tokens for CI, use repo secrets with masking and rotate them frequently. also ensure `actions/set-output` and similar calls don't echo secrets.

jia: i'll open a follow-up ticket to capture these checks and update the runbook. SEC-3744: add checklist: avoid env-bake, prefer file mounts, enable runtime redaction regex, CI OIDC, rotation cadence documented. @ben can you confirm vault policies for private customers allow monthly rotation?

ben: will confirm in the ticket and drop the policy diff. quick local check command you can run (do NOT paste output here): `kubectl logs -l app=redwood-runtime | grep -i token` — if you see raw tokens, we need a redaction rule.

sec-bot: Rotation policy template applied to account 'private-prod' on 2026-02-10. See /policies/rotation-template-v2. :package:

maria: awesome, thanks everyone — i'll update the runbook draft and link SEC-3744. tagging @sophie for HSM notes later. :pray:
